solution.text:
We have ω=vR for pure rolling.



The velocity of point P is resultant of two velocity vectors shown as arrows in the figure. Hence,

         v → P = v x i ^ + v y j ^

or      v → P = v + v r sin θ R i ^ - v r cos θ R j ^
